messages:
sam: Heads-up 1 - product needs a clear RA decision on reserved-pools burst prioritization by EOD Monday. Customer asks piling up.
anya: Which knobs are still undecided?
raj: We haven't agreed on default max_burst_per_tenant, rollover policy, or whether prewarm credits are per-window or continuous.
lina: SRE: priority is predictable tail latency. If default max_burst > 2x without prewarm, 95p jumps. Recommend safeguard: hard-guard at 3x with progressive throttling.
michael: Sales/CS input: some pilots want guaranteed micro-windows (30s) daily; others prefer flexible on-demand. Could be an enterprise add-on.
sam: Proposal: GA defaults = max_burst_per_tenant: 150, contracted_burst_window_s: 30 (opt-in only), monthly_rollover: true up to 100% cap, credit_expiry_cycles: 1. Enterprise can contract extra.
anya: Ops asks: include admin endpoints for shed/drain and credit adjustments plus audit events. Also telemetry tags: burst_source and spill_cause.
raj: I'll add Prom metrics for burst_redeemed_total and a gate rule for canary: 95p latency < 300ms, burst_retry_rate delta < 0.5%.
lina: Runbook snippet: if >2 tenants hit hard-cap in 10m -> page SRE, call for partial drain, run reconcile. Include exact commands.
michael: I'll draft comms + SLA appendix wording for expiry and rollover; loop Legal.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: reserve-burst-alpha feature-flag toggled ON for staging.
sam: Next steps: (1) Raj - metrics + gate (Thu), (2) Lina - runbook + admin endpoints (RFC Fri), (3) Michael - comms + legal wording (Fri), (4) Anya - final decision doc (Mon). Review Mon 9am.
anya: Agreed. Mark "contracted-burst-window" as enterprise add-on. Any objections?
raj: No objections. Will prototype gate rules this week.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging canary completed - 0 failures.
sam: Thanks all. If we get new customer asks, drop here and we'll triage.
